summary: Iteration 20 — Focused re-verification of the two fixes flagged in iteration 19. (1) POST /api/v1/walkins duplicate-key 500 — FIXED. 5 walkins for the fixture user with DIFFERENT employers all return 201, 6th returns 429 with detail.error='walkin_rate_limited'. GET /walkins/mine lists all 5 newest-first. GET /applications shows 5 companion rows with route='walkin' and job_id starting with 'walkin:' (all distinct). (2) Frontend chip data-testids — FIXED. On /feed for the fixture user we count job-card-velocity-chip=9, job-card-lane-chip=9 (all 'Career' — SampleCo lane seed applied), job-card-distance-chip=6 (Phoenix-based). All Phase-3 unit + live integration suites still pass: tests/test_gate_engine.py (23) + tests/test_phase3_safeguards.py (11) + tests/test_phase3_integration_live.py (14) = 48/48. New tests/test_iter20_walkin_and_chips.py (3) = 3/3. Total 51/51 backend PASS.

minor.issue: The rebase to_wipe list in backend/domains/seeds/seeder.py::_rebase_fixture_user (line 351-359) does NOT include 'walkins' or 'personas'. As a result, walk-ins created by earlier test runs persist across backend restarts and count against the 5/hr rate-limit, causing later CI runs (including the review-request 5→201/6th→429 scenario) to spuriously receive 429 on the FIRST call. Also the rebase response 'note' field lies about wiping applications+consent_records but doesn't mention walkins/personas. Recommend adding 'walkins' and 'personas' to the to_wipe list so the rebase truly returns the fixture user to a clean baseline. Iteration 20 works around this by direct MongoDB delete_many on walkins in the test module fixture.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Add 'walkins' and 'personas' to the to_wipe list in backend/domains/seeds/seeder.py::_rebase_fixture_user so /api/internal/fixture/rebase truly resets the fixture user's walk-in history. Without this, downstream test agents will keep tripping the 5/hr rate limiter unless they wipe the walkins collection directly (as iteration 20 does).

frontend/src/pages/Feed.jsx — data-testid attributes 'job-card-velocity-chip', 'job-card-lane-chip', 'job-card-distance-chip' present on the correct <span> nodes (lines 301, 312, 322). Verified live in the preview.
backend/domains/seeds/seeder.py::_rebase_fixture_user to_wipe list — missing 'walkins' and 'personas' collections. Test infra debt: causes false-positive 429 on cold reruns.

backend/domains/walkin/__init__.py::_rate_limit uses a DB count on the walkins collection; there is no per-test bypass, and because walkins are not wiped by fixture rebase, long-lived preview environments accumulate walk-ins for the fixture user and eventually block automated tests permanently. Consider either wiping walkins on rebase (preferred) or introducing a service-token override.
